title: [29.x]-Bug 658800: [Expense Agent] Expense User Card rejects manual approval setup with duplicate error
summary: Fixes a bug in the Expense Agent where manually adding an approval setup from the Expense User Card failed with a duplicate error. The change is in the Expense Approval Setups Part page and is a backport to 29.x.
key_points: Adding an approval setup manually from the Expense User Card no longer fails with a duplicate error
The change is in page 6947 Expense Approval Setups Part
Tests were added to the Expense Agent test codeunit
